In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
global sales manager leadership styles are a function of national culture.
a global sales manager should use a participative leadership style in countries that are collectivistic, low in power distance, and high in uncertainty avoidance.
the most effective leadership styles in the different cultural environments are participative, supportive, and achievement-oriented.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most effective leadership styles are those which are consistent with the culture of the salesperson.

sales managers who are more participative, supportive and achievement-oriented are likely to have better sales force performance in cultures with a high power distance, high individualism, and low masculinity.

global sales managers should be aware of the influence of national culture on their leadership styles and that they should adapt their leadership style accordingly to achieve the highest levels of performance from their salespeople.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most appropriate leadership style for global sales managers to use is dependent upon the culture of the country in which they are working.
sales managers should use a participative leadership style in collectivistic countries and a supportive leadership style in individualistic countries.
the most effective leadership styles are not the same across cultures.
